n-k-k9-01.title: Ngaba isihloko sithi okungakumbi kunophando?
n-k-k9-01.goal: Thelekisa isihloko seendaba namanani ophando esiqwengeni, gqiba ukuba ngawaphi amagama esihloko agqithisa ubungqina, uze ubhale isihloko esingakwenzi oko.
n-k-k9-01.material:
Iwebhusayithi yeendaba zasekhaya yapapasha eli nqaku.

[제목] 주민 대다수, 공원 야간 개방에 찬성

[본문] 구청이 지난 3일 공원 이용객 50명에게 설문한 결과, 야간 개방에 찬성한 사람은 28명이었다. 반대는 15명, 모르겠다는 응답은 7명이었다. 설문은 낮 시간에 공원 입구에서만 진행됐다. 구청은 "주민 전체의 의견으로 보기는 어렵다"며 추가 조사를 하겠다고 밝혔다.
n-k-k9-01.thinking.1: Ukuqaphela amagama obungakanani (대다수, 과반) namagama amaqela (주민, 이용객)
n-k-k9-01.prereq.0: Unokufunda inqaku elifutshane leendaba ngesimbo esibhaliweyo (-했다, -밝혔다)
n-k-k9-01.prereq.1: Uyawazi amagama 찬성/반대, 설문, 응답, 절반
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.prompt: Thelekisa isihloko namanani asemizimbeni. Ngawaphi amagama esihloko agqithisa oko ophando lukubonisayo? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala phantsi ukuba ngubani obuzwe, phi nini, usebenzisa kuphela umbhalo ophambili.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.1: Guqula 28 kwi-50 ibe sisabelo, emva koko ubuze ukuba eso sabelo siyahambelana negama lobungakanani esihlokweni.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.c: Inkxaso ichanekile ngokwezo zathethwa ngabantu abangama-28, ngoko eli gama lixhaswa ngamanani.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.d: Ukuvulwa ebusuku sisihloko sombuzo wophando, ngoko eli gama nalo lixhaswa.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.explain: Ababuziweyo ngabadlulayo kuphela kwindawo yokungena kwipaki emini, ngoko '주민' banzi ngakumbi kunobungqina. 28 kwi-50 ziyi-56 yepesenti, ngaphezulu nje kwesiqingatha, esingesiyo '대다수'. '찬성' kunye '야간 개방' zihambelana nophando.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.0: Iqela lenene liyagqithisa (inqaku ngokwalo liyathi). Hlola kwakhona ukuba 대다수 inamandla kangakanani kwi-28 kwi-50.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.1: Igama lamandla liyagqithisa ngenene. Hlola kwakhona ukuba ngubani obuzwe ngenene: iindwendwe kuphela kwindawo enye nexesha elinye.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.prompt: Sesiphi isihloko esiya kuhambelana kakhulu nobungqina?
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola isihloko ngasinye ngezinto ezimbini: iqela nenani.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.1: Phinda ubale isabelo senketho esebenzisa ipesenti eyahlukileyo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.a: Oku kusathi 주민, iqela elingagutyungelwanga luphando, nangona 과반 ihambelana nesabelo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.c: Ipesenti engama-70 idibanisa abantu abangama-28 abavumayo nabangama-7 abaphendule 'andiqinisekanga'; yi-56 yepesenti kuphela eyathi iyavuma.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.d: 28 ezivumayo ngokuchasene nezili-15 ezichasayo ayisiyo ahlulelwano elilinganayo, kwaye 주민 ibanzi kakhulu kwakhona.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.explain: 28 kwi-50 ziyi-56 yepesenti, yaye ababuziweyo ngabandwendwe bepaki. Isihloko sibiza iqela nenani.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala isihloko esitsha SIMNYE (umgca omnye ngesiKorean) esixela olu phando ngaphandle kokugqithisa.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngeqela elibuziweyo, emva koko inani okanye isabelo, emva koko isenzi 찬성.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.1: Shiya nawuphi na igama elibanzi okanye elinamandla ngakumbi kunoko ungakubala.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umfundi unokwazi ukuba ngubani ophendule uphando?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba inani esihlokweni sam lelo ndinokulibala kumzimba?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba kukho igama elenza isiphumo sivakale sinamandla ngakumbi kune-56 yepesenti yeendwendwe ezingama-50?

n-k-k9-03.title: Ngubani onokujoyina inkampu yokufaka ikhowudi?
n-k-k9-03.topic: Imida emithethweni: 이상, 이하, 초과, 미만 (yakha izisombululo ezininzi)
n-k-k9-03.goal: Funda isibhengezo esinamagama emida, usebenze ukuba ngawaphi amaxabiso avunyelweyo, yakha amaqela amaninzi anelisa yonke imithetho ngaxeshanye, uze uxele elinye ngesiKorean.
n-k-k9-03.thinking.0: Ukufunda amagama emida (이상, 이하, 초과, 미만) ngokuchanekileyo
n-k-k9-03.thinking.1: Ukufumana isiphumo esifihlakeleyo (intlawulo ithintela ubungakanani beqela)
n-k-k9-03.thinking.2: Ukuvelisa izisombululo ezininzi ezisebenzayo nokuhlola nganye
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.prompt: Zeziphi izitatimenti ezivunyelwe sisibhengezo? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba umgca wamanani uphawule inani ngalinye lomda njengelibandakanyiweyo okanye elingabandakanywanga.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuba igama lithetha 'kubandakanya eli nani' okanye 'ngaphaya kwenani'.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.b: Hlola oko 미만 kwenza kwinani ngokwalo: 'ngaphantsi kwe-19' akubandakanyi i-19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.c: Intlawulo yeqela eyi-20,000 won ncam yayiya kulunga.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.c: Hlola oko 초과 kwenza kwinani ngokwalo: 'ngaphezu kwe-20,000' akubandakanyi i-20,000.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.d: Intlawulo yeqela eyi-30,000 won ncam yayiya kulunga.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.explain: 이상 kunye 이하 zibandakanya inani ngokwalo; 초과 kunye 미만 aziyenzi. Ngoko u-14 ungaphakathi, u-19 ungaphandle, u-20,000 ungaphandle yaye u-30,000 ungaphakathi.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.prompt: Yakha amaqela ama-3 ahlukeneyo anelisa yonke imithetho. n = inani lamalungu, y = ubudala belungu elincinci, o = ubudala belungu elikhulu (iminyaka epheleleyo).
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bala intlawulo yamalungu ama-3, ama-4 nama-5 phambi kokukhetha iminyaka.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha ubudala obuncinci kuqala, emva koko obona bukhulu ngaphakathi kweminyaka emi-3 nangaphantsi kwe-19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Wonke umntu uneminyaka eyi-14 okanye ngaphezulu.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ilungu elikhulu kufuneka libe ngaphantsi kwe-만 19세, ngoko u-19 awuvumelekanga.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Elona likhulu lilingana ubuncinane nelincinci ngobudala.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c6: Intlawulo yeqela ingaphezu kwe-20,000 kwaye ayingaphezu kwe-30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c6: Intlawulo yeqela (7,000 x amalungu) kufuneka ibe ngaphezu kwe-20,000 kwaye ingabi ngaphezu kwe-30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.explain: Umthetho wentlawulo uvumela amalungu ama-3 kuphela (21,000 won) okanye ama-4 (28,000 won), nangona umthetho weqela uthi ukuya kuma-5. Iminyaka kufuneka ihlale phakathi kwe-14 ne-18 ngomahluko ongekho ngaphezu kwe-3.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha IQELA LAKHO ELIMNYE ubhale umyalezo omfutshane wokubhalisa kumququzeleli ngesiKorean (intetho ehloniphekileyo): inani lamalungu, iminyaka yelona lincinci nelona likhulu, nentlawulo ipheleleyo.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa umqolo omnye ovela kumaqela akho: amanani amathathu.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bhala amalungu, emva koko iminyaka, emva koko intlawulo, uphelise isivakalisi ngasinye ngembeko.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba amanani akumyalezo wam ahambelana neqela elinye endiliyakhileyo?
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba intlawulo epheleleyo yi-7,000 won izihlandlo inani lamalungu?

n-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.0: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-k-k9-04.goal: Funda isivakalisi esinye njengoko umxholo ongakumbi ufika, qaphela indlela intsingiselo ejika ngayo phakathi kokubonga nokuqhayisa, uze uphendule ngembeko kwingxelo yokuqhayisa.
n-k-k9-04.material: NgeMivulo ekuseni. Iqela lakho linendibano yeveki nganye. Ungena egumbini kwaye 팀장님 yakho (inkokeli yeqela) ikuxelela isivakalisi esinye. Funda inxalenye nganye, ukhethe indlela yokufunda ebonakala inokwenzeka kakhulu, uze uqhubeke.
n-k-k9-04.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya indlela yokufunda xa iinyani ezintsha zifika
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda inxalenye nganye ukhethe intsingiselo enokwenzeka kakhulu yesivakalisi sika-팀장님 phambi kokuba uqhubeke.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuba ziziphi iinyani ezimalunga nexesha nendlela yothethayo ezinokwenza amagama abe yinyani okanye abe lixoki.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yintoni 팀장님 ekuyo mhlawumbi ngalesi sivakalisi?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngaphandle komxholo zomibini iindlela zokufunda ziyenzeka: '참 ...도' inokubonisa ukwamkela okunyanisekileyo okanye ukugqithisa ngokuqhayisa. Amagama odwa awagqibi.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akukho nto kwisivakalisi icela utshintsho lwexesha elizayo; isicelo sasiya kusebenzisa isiphelo esinjenge -아 주세요.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kuthethwe okuchasene nenyani (kwangoko ngokuchasene nemizuzu engama-40 emva kwexesha), ngaphandle kombhoxo: oku kuqhayisa. Umfundi oguqulela amagama kuphela wayeya kuphosa uhlolo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Indibano sele iyimizuzu engama-40 iqalile, ngoko akukho namnye unokubonga ngokunyanisekileyo oku kufika.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Othethayo akabuzi nto; ukujonga kwiwotshi kukhomba kwingxelo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngolu lwazi lutsha, isivakalisi sika-팀장님 sithetha ntoni?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Iinyani ngoku ziyahambelana namagama, ngoko isivakalisi sithethwe ngokoqobo (mhlawumbi ngobubele). Umxholo unokudala ukuqhayisa kwaye ukususe.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ngendibano ngo-10:30 ufike imizuzu engama-50 kwangoko, ngoko akukho kufika emva kwexesha kokugweba.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Akukho mqondiso walo; ikofu nokuncuma zikhomba kubuhlobo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Isivakalisi asisosimbuzo yaye isaziso asikhankanywanga kuso.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.reflect: Amagama awazange atshintshe; iinyani zatshintsha. Xa isivakalisi sithi into engahambelani neenyani (apha, 'kwangoko' kumntu ofike emva kwexesha), umphulaphuli usifunda njengokuqhayisa (반어). Iinyani ezintsha zinokususa kwakhona ukufunda okunjalo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.prompt: Buyela kwinxalenye yesibini: indibano yaqala ngo-9:00 yaye ufike ngo-9:40. Phendula 팀장님 ngentetho ehloniphekileyo, uphendula oko ingxelo ithetha ngokwenene.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubiza oko ukwenze kakubi ngamagama amafutshane.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba impendulo yam ibonisa ukuba ndiyiqonde ingxelo njengokugweba?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba isizathu sam okanye isithembiso sinokwamkelwa ngumsebenzi esebenza naye?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ndingathetha ngale ndlela ku-팀장님 yam (ngembeko, ndingazikhuseli)?

n-k-k9-02.title: Isidibanisi esiguqula impikiswano
n-k-k9-02.goal: Fumana umgca onesidibanisi esikhomba impikiswano kwicala elingalunganga, ukhethe isidibanisi esibuyisela ingqiqo, uze uphinde ubhale lo mgca.
n-k-k9-02.material: Umfundi wabhala isiqendu esifutshane malunga nokusebenza ekhaya kumagazini wesikolo. Isidibanisi esinye asihambelani nengqiqo.
n-k-k9-02.thinking.0: Ukufunda izidibanisi njengemiqondiso yesalathiso (ukongeza, ukuchasana, isiphumo)
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca onesidibanisi sokuqala esisebenza ngokuchasene nesalathiso sempikiswano.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.0: Yithi ngamazwi akho ukuba umgca ngamnye wenza msebenzi muni kwisiqendu, emva koko jonga ukuba igama lawo lokuqala liwudibanisa njani nomgca wangaphambili.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kwisidibanisi ngasinye buza ukuba umgca uyaqhubeka kwicala lomgca wangaphambili okanye uyajika uchasene nalo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.explain: Umgca 3 uguquka ukusuka kwinzuzo (umgca 2) uye kwingxaki, kodwa isidibanisi sawo songeza okuthe ngqo kwinto efanayo. Igama lokuchasana liyafuneka apho. Imigca 4 no-5 inika isiphumo nesigqibo ngokufanelekileyo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.prompt: Sesiphi isidibanisi esifanele sithathe indawo yegama lokuqala lalo mgca?
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.0: Yithi ngesiNgesi ukuba umgca unolwalamano luni nowangaphambili.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.1: Zama inketho nganye kwisivakalisi ubone ukuba imigca emibini isaqonda kunye.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.a: Oku kuya kuthi ingxaki sisiphumo senzuzo, esingenangqondo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.d: Oku kuya kubonisa ingxaki njengesizathu senzuzo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.explain: Isiqendu sisuka kwinzuzo siye kwisithintelo, ngoko isidibanisi kufuneka siphawule ukuchasana.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.prompt: Phinda ubhale umgca onengxaki kunye nesidibanisi esifanelekileyo (gcina intsalela yesivakalisi). Emva koko wongeze isivakalisi SAKHO esinye esiqala ngegama lesiphumo (umzekelo 그래서 okanye 따라서) elilandela engxakini.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tshintsha igama lokuqala kuphela lomgca onengxaki.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kwisivakalisi esitsha, buza: ngenxa yale ngxaki, kwenziwa ntoni okanye kufuneka ntoni kwiinkampani?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba isidibanisi sam esitsha sibonisa ukujika ukusuka kwinzuzo uye kwingxaki?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba isivakalisi sam esongezelelweyo silandela ngokwenene engxakini, hayi enzuzweni?

n-k-k9-05.title: Ukuxelela ugogo ngexabiso lebhasi
n-k-k9-05.topic: Iindaba kwisiKorean sentetho sogogo (phinda ubhale kubaphulaphuli)
n-k-k9-05.goal: Phinda ubhale isivakalisi seendaba ngesiKorean esithethwayo esihloniphekileyo sogogo oneminyaka engama-68, ugcine oko kuqinisekileyo, oko kucetywayo kuphela, noko kusebenza kuye.
n-k-k9-05.material:
Ufunde eli nqaku leendaba kwifowuni yakho. Ugogo wakho (oneminyaka engama-68) uhlala nawe kwaye ukhwela ibhasi imihla ngemihla. Akafundi iindaba.

[기사] 시는 다음 달 1일부터 시내버스 기본요금을 1,500원에서 1,700원으로 200원 인상할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 다만 만 65세 이상 어르신의 요금은 현행 1,500원으로 유지된다.
n-k-k9-05.thinking.0: Ukutshintsha irejista nokukhethwa kwamagama komphulaphuli omtsha
n-k-k9-05.thinking.1: Ukugcina iinyani nobume bazo (kucetywa, akenziwanga) xa uphinda uxela
n-k-k9-05.thinking.2: Ukubeka phambili oko kubalulekileyo kulo mphulaphuli
n-k-k9-05.prereq.1: Uyayazi 존댓말 ngokuchasene nesimbo esibhaliweyo seendaba
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.prompt: Uya kuxelela ugogo wakho ngelizwi. Sisiphi isixeko ekuxelweni kwaso uya kujija iindaba?
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funda inqaku kanye uze udwelise iinyani zalo (nini, malini, ngubani ohlawula ntoni, qiniseko kangakanani). Emva koko phawula inyani nganye kuyo yonke imibalisi.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela umbalisi apho enye yeenyani zakho ezidweliswe ilahlekile okanye ijikisiwe.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.a: Ixabiso lebhasi liya kunyuka nge-200 won kwinyanga ezayo, kodwa hayi kubantu abadala.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.a: Oku kugcina isicwangciso, isixa nokungabandakanywa, ngoko kunyanisekile.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.b: Ixabiso lebhasi liya kunyuka nge-200 won kwinyanga ezayo kuye wonke umntu.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.c: Ukusuka kwinyanga ezayo abantu abadala baqhubeka behlawula i-1,500 won; abanye bahlawula i-200 won ngaphezulu.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.c: Oku kunyanisekile yaye kubeka inxalenye yabantu abadala kuqala.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.d: Isixeko sithi ixabiso liya kunyuka nge-200 won ukusuka kwinyanga ezayo.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.d: Oku kunyanisekile: kugcina ukuba ngubani oyithethileyo nokuba kusengumbono.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.explain: Inqaku lithi ixabiso licetywa ukunyuka kwinyanga ezayo kwaye abantu abaneminyaka engama-65 nangaphezulu bagcina ixabiso lakudala. Inguqulelo ejijiweyo ithi ukunyuka kusebenza kuye wonke umntu, ngoko ilahla ukungabandakanywa okubalulekileyo kugogo wakho.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.prompt: Sesiphi isivakalisi sokuvula esifanelekileyo ekuthetheni nogogo wakho?
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.0: Jonga iziphelo zezivakalisi: zeziphi ezeposi leendaba nezeziphi zegumbi losapho?
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba isenziligama losuku ngalunye okanye ligama lephephandaba.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.b: Esi sibhengezo sesimbo seendaba kwaye siqinile kakhulu kwincoko yosapho.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.c: Isiphelo esiqhelekileyo esithe tye asihloniphekanga kugogo, yaye -니까 ivakala ngathi akunamonde.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.d: '인상되오니 … 바랍니다' lulwimi lwebhodi yezaziso, yaye lubonisa ukunyuka njengokwenziwe kunokuba lixelwa.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.explain: Intetho yosapho kumntu omdala ihloniphekile kodwa ithambile (-요), isebenzisa amagama osuku ngalunye (오르다 kunokuba 인상되다) yaye -대요 ixela oko omnye umntu akuthethileyo.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku xelela ugogo wakho ngamazwi akho esiKorean: izivakalisi ezimbini ubuninzi, intetho ehloniphekileyo ye -요, akukho ziphelo zephephandaba. Gcina umhla, isixa, ukuba kucetywa kuphela, noko kusebenza kuye.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.0: Isivakalisi sokuqala: nini, malini, kwaye ukuba sisicwangciso. Isivakalisi sesibini: oko kuthetha kuye.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.1: Tshintsha lonke igama lephephandaba ngegama ongalisebenzisa etafileni yesidlo.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba inguqulelo yam isathi ukunyuka kucetywa kuphela?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ugogo wayeya kwazi ukuba yena ngokwakhe uhlawula ngokufanayo?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba amagama am ngawo ndiya kuwathetha ekhaya ngokwenene?
